data.name: Logix FlexiDisk II

usable_from: Apple II with Logix Apple II Expansion Card

manufacturing_requirements: controller and firmware able to handle each specified encoding/format, sector/track buffering, local CPU/ROM/RAM, PSU/enclosure and separate format-interchange tests. Define formatting and read/write capability explicitly. Avoid silently using the standard FlexiDisk BOM if its controller cannot implement both formats.
